svg.aria-label: Application architecture: 19 elements and 26 relationships, grouped into 7 drawn elements and 9 drawn relationships

g.desc: Module: Channel & customer (2 responsibilities, 2 components, …). It implements External systems of no stated kind; hands Control & accounting “2 relationships”. Bank Payment Journey composes ×2 it; Settlement hands it “2 relationships”.

Module: Control & accounting (2 interfaces, 2 responsibilities, …). It uses Ledger posting; hands Settlement “2 relationships”. Bank Payment Journey composes ×2 it; Channel & customer hands it “2 relationships”.

Module: Settlement (1 interface, 1 responsibility, …). It uses Settlement submission and enquiry; hands Channel & customer “2 relationships”. Bank Payment Journey composes it; Control & accounting hands it “2 relationships”.
Party kind: External systems of no stated kind (1 interface, 1 external system). Channel & customer implements it.
Application service IF-002: Ledger posting. Control & accounting uses it.
Application service IF-003: Settlement submission and enquiry. Settlement uses it.
Physical application component: Bank Payment Journey (The application as a whole). It composes ×2 Channel & customer; composes ×2 Control & accounting; composes Settlement.

g.aria-label: Party kind External systems of no stated kind
